notes: Pinned worker skill bundle. Entries tagged 'discipline' are delivered to every execute lane; every non-delegation entry is additionally selectable by exact name via the repeatable --skill flag (for example --skill qa-on-demand), which is additive to the discipline defaults and closed under references: a selected skill that references a manifest sibling pulls that sibling in, and a reference to anything outside the manifest fails delivery. 'package' sources ship inside this plugin and are hash-pinned here; 'repo' sources (the private QA skills qa-on-demand and site-uat-sweep) point at the dev-tools checkout's canonical skill trees, are never published in this public package, and resolve only when the runner executes from a dev-tools checkout — their delivered records pin that checkout's HEAD commit. Delegation-tagged entries are never selectable and never delivered: worker lanes run without subworkers. Coordinator-side skills (prompt-it, side-lane) are deliberately absent: workers must not re-enter coordinator gates or route dispatch.
